verdict.rationale: A government business-filing portal could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring filings, payments, or report submissions, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents scheduling recurring jobs or workflows. The Gateway and OH|TAX items cover profile updates, one-off filing, payments and refund checks, and the probes show the ohiosos.gov hosts block agents at robots.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
